name: geometric-minimal
description: Corporate, formal, professional — thin strokes, subtle patterns, understated elegance

dividers.deco-line-h: height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--color-accent) 20%, var(--color-accent) 80%, transparent); opacity: 0.6;
dividers.deco-line-v: width: 1px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, var(--color-accent) 20%, var(--color-accent) 80%, transparent); opacity: 0.6;

brackets.deco-bracket-tl: position: absolute; top: 16px; left: 16px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-accent); border-left: 1px solid var(--color-accent); opacity: 0.5;
brackets.deco-bracket-tr: position: absolute; top: 16px; right: 16px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-accent); border-right: 1px solid var(--color-accent); opacity: 0.5;
brackets.deco-bracket-bl: position: absolute; bottom: 16px; left: 16px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-accent); border-left: 1px solid var(--color-accent); opacity: 0.5;
brackets.deco-bracket-br: position: absolute; bottom: 16px; right: 16px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-accent); border-right: 1px solid var(--color-accent); opacity: 0.5;

stripes.deco-stripe-top: position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 3px; background: var(--color-accent);
stripes.deco-stripe-left: position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; bottom: 0; width: 3px; background: var(--color-accent);

orbs.deco-orb-sm: position: absolute; width: 200px; height: 200px; border-radius: 50%; filter: blur(100px); opacity: 0.08;
orbs.deco-orb-lg: position: absolute; width: 400px; height: 400px; border-radius: 50%; filter: blur(100px); opacity: 0.08;

patterns.deco-pattern-dots: background-image: radial-gradient(circle, var(--color-accent) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 24px 24px; opacity: 0.06;
patterns.deco-pattern-diagonals: background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, var(--color-accent) 0, var(--color-accent) 1px, transparent 0, transparent 50%); background-size: 16px 16px; opacity: 0.04;
patterns.deco-pattern-crosses: background-image: radial-gradient(circle, var(--color-accent) 1px, transparent 1px), radial-gradient(circle, var(--color-accent) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 24px 24px, 24px 24px; background-position: 0 0, 12px 12px; opacity: 0.05;

shapes.deco-shape-circle: position: absolute; width: 80px; height: 80px; border: 1px solid var(--color-accent); border-radius: 50%; opacity: 0.3;
shapes.deco-shape-triangle: position: absolute; width: 0; height: 0; border-left: 40px solid transparent; border-right: 40px solid transparent; border-bottom: 70px solid var(--color-accent); opacity: 0.15;
shapes.deco-shape-hex: position: absolute; width: 80px; height: 46px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--color-accent); opacity: 0.25; clip-path: polygon(25% 0%, 75% 0%, 100% 50%, 75% 100%, 25% 100%, 0% 50%);
